summary.text: Carolyn Jackson is a Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 1 since November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jackson took office in the Indiana House on November 7, 2018, succeeding Linda Lawson.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.

In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, Jackson listed her top priorities as improving the quality of life in Hammond and Whiting, bringing additional social service programs for seniors and veterans, and providing better educational opportunities for all children, including expanded pre-kindergarten.
In the same survey she said honesty, integrity, transparency, and being accessible to constituents were the most important characteristics for an elected official.
